g.text: How turnout changed in each political group
Change in turnout from the 2022 to the 2026 Knesset election in Israeli localities, grouped by how they voted in 2022.
Each locality counts once, whatever its size.

Coalition: Likud, Religious Zionism, Shas, United Torah Judaism. Opposition: Yesh Atid, National Unity, Yisrael Beiteinu, Labor, Meretz. Balance = (coalition − opposition) ÷ (coalition + opposition) votes, 2022.
Arab-party plurality: Ra'am, Hadash–Ta'al or Balad was the single most-voted list in 2022. Turnout = votes ÷ eligible voters at the locality's ballot boxes (double envelopes excluded).
Sources: Central Elections Committee 2022 final results; 2026 22:00 election-day turnout report by ballot box (preliminary, not final). n = 1,215 localities.
